title: Taking a shirt back
instructions: Mark aldığı gömleği geri getiriyor. Sorunun ne olduğuna ve sonuca dikkat et.

script.speaker: mark
script.text: Hi. I bought this shirt here last week, but there is a problem.

script.speaker: assistant
script.text: Oh, I'm sorry. What's wrong with it?

script.speaker: mark
script.text: It's too small. I usually wear a large, but this is a medium.

script.speaker: assistant
script.text: Thank you. I'm sorry, we don't have this shirt in large now. Would you like a different colour?

script.speaker: mark
script.text: No, thanks. I don't like the other colours. Can I have my money back?

script.speaker: assistant
script.text: Of course. That's thirty-five pounds back on your card.

questions.prompt: When did Mark buy the shirt?
questions.evidence: I bought this shirt here last week

questions.prompt: What is the problem with the shirt?
questions.feedback: Gömlek çok küçük (too small): large giyiyor ama bu medium.

questions.prompt: Why can't Mark change the shirt?
options: There are no large shirts now.
questions.feedback: Mağazada şu an large beden yok.
questions.evidence: we don't have this shirt in large now.

questions.prompt: What does Mark get in the end?
questions.feedback: Başka renk istemiyor; parasını geri alıyor (money back).
questions.evidence: Can I have my money back?
